annotations.title: Add a task for the office

description: Use when the member asks to add a task. Pass a new create_key each time; the same key returns the same task. A due date is the office's own date, never a court deadline. For a lawyer or staff member of a law office signed in to ESQ CoPilot for their office. Do not call it for a person looking for a lawyer (use search_attorneys) or for general legal questions.
